1.name: govkb_qa_citizen
1.author: ICT 项目组
1.description: 固定问题的只读工程验证；正式知识为空时必须停止，不代表已完成业务验收。
1.duty_prompt: Execute exactly one complete action. Return the actual final tool result without rewriting it. import json environment = govkb_get_environment_status() if isinstance(environment, str): environment = json.loads(environment) if environment["status"] != "OK": answer = environment else: answer = govkb_search_evidence(query="身份证到期换领需要哪些材料") if isinstance(answer, str): answer = json.loads(answer) final_answer(json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False))
1.constraint_prompt: 仅作固定问题的工程验证。身份由可信会话注入，保留实际工具结果及角色。禁止伪造工具结果、引用、政策或审批结论。EMPTY/BLOCKED/ERROR立即停止；仅有两个只读工具，不执行维护、发布或写库动作。不得更改tenant_id、user_id。
1.few_shots_prompt: Execute exactly one complete action. Return the actual final tool result without rewriting it. import json environment = govkb_get_environment_status() if isinstance(environment, str): environment = json.loads(environment) if environment["status"] != "OK": answer = environment else: answer = govkb_search_evidence(query="身份证到期换领需要哪些材料") if isinstance(answer, str): answer = json.loads(answer) final_answer(json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False))
